game.title: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Detroit Lions -7.1 with a fair total of 50.2, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Detroit Lions pass offence vs Green Bay Packers pass defence, which sits +0.251 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
